title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Order Form Schedule — Tier Bands, Minimum Term and Closure Figures
content:
Each tier of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service covers a band of monthly disbursement counts and carries its own minimum term, early closure fee and closure refund timeline.

| Tier | Monthly disbursement band | Consecutive months in another band before a move | Minimum term (months) | Early closure fee (USD) | Business days after closure to return the remaining balance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 to 249 | 3 | 0 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 250 to 999 | 3 | 0 | 0.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 1000 to 4999 | 3 | 12 | 250.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 5000 to 19999 | 3 | 12 | 500.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 20000 to 74999 | 3 | 12 | 1000.00 | 5 |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 75000 to 10000000 | 3 | 24 | 2500.00 | 5 |

## Definitions

- **Monthly disbursement band** — the range of monthly disbursement counts, both ends included, that the tier covers.
- **Consecutive months** — consecutive months of disbursement counts in another tier's band after which the service moves to that tier (count).
- **Minimum term** — minimum term (months).
- **Early closure fee** — fee when the service closes before its minimum term (USD).
- **Refund timeline** — business days after closure within which the remaining prefund balance is returned to the employer's bank (count).

## Points of reading

- Starter and Core have no minimum term, and their early closure fee is 0.00.
- A hypothetical month of 999 disbursements lies in the Core band; a month of 1000 lies in the Growth band.
